verdict.rationale: Granola's REST API is path-versioned under /v1 and has a dated, semantically versioned changelog (v1.0.0–v1.6.0) that lists endpoint and response changes, so the versioning half of the story is delivered. However, the docs explicitly publish no deprecation window or backward-compatibility commitment, so the deprecation-policy half is absent. missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy (sunset windows, notice periods), a backward-compatibility guarantee, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
